description: Document to Markdown with per-page hashes and offsets — Converts a PDF (text layer), DOCX, XLSX or PPTX file, or normalizes an HTML, Markdown, text, CSV or JSON file, into Markdown (or plain text) for an agent that must read or cite a document. Give an https URL or up to 4 MB as base64. Returns the content plus one unit per page, sheet or slide with its exact character range in the content and a SHA-256 of that unit's text, so later quote and citation

content_base64.description: Standard padded base64 of the file, at most 4 MB decoded. Provide this or url.

describe.description: Also suggest a file name, tags and a summary with a language model. Default false.

filename.description: Original file name; helps format detection and is kept as the extension of the suggested name.

max_chars.description: Output cap in characters, cut at a unit boundary. Default 120000.

pages.description: Page, sheet or slide selection such as "1-5,8", at most 200 pages. Default: the first 200.

url.description: https URL of the document. Provide this or content_base64.

name: doc-to-markdown
